notes: My own reading: the average translational kinetic energy per molecule is (3/2)kT, which contains only the temperature. Hydrogen and oxygen are at the same temperature, so the ratio is 1 : 1, option 3. The same conclusion holds per mole, (3/2)RT, so the answer does not depend on whether the question means per molecule or per mole. Checked and did not file: the why_this_step says the mass "cancels out of the kinetic energy expression once written in terms of temperature", which is loosely worded but true in substance, since (1/2)m<v²> becomes (3/2)kT with no m left. The single mistake entry names a real belief, that a heavier molecule carries more kinetic energy, and correctly carries option null because the molar-mass ratio 1:16 is not among the listed options.
